# Acquisition dashboard — definitions, thresholds, and what may not be printed

**Generated by:** `crm.dashboard.render`, nightly 05:00 ET, from the counters and a signature-verified
`claims.json`. **A hand edit to this file is overwritten on the next run.**
**As of:** 2026-08-13 · **Register state: OPEN, NO DATA.** No test has started, no page is published,
no account exists. Every current value below reads `—` for that reason and for no other.
**Scope A** (`CORRECTIONS.md` §3.1): nothing on this page is customer-facing copy, and no figure here
may be lifted onto a public surface except through §5.

---

## 1. The four questions this dashboard exists to answer

1. **Is provenance the draw?** (T1 — the load-bearing assumption of the whole brand.)
2. **Can we hold a search surface nobody else holds?** (T2 — the revision history, not the rate.)
3. **Does anyone pay?** (T3 — the only instrument that returns a money answer in weeks.)
4. **Does the artifact loop have any yield at all?** (Instrumented, not planned against.)

Everything else on this page is either an input to one of those four or a gate that stops us saying
something we have not measured.

---

## 2. Metric definitions

Rules that apply to every row: a metric is printed with its **denominator** and its **as-of date** or
it is not printed; a missing day is recorded as missing and never interpolated; and a ratio whose
denominator is below its stated floor renders `—`, not zero.

### 2.1 T1 — the free tools (`crm.tool.funnel`, daily)

| id | Metric | Definition | Threshold | Current |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t1.gen_runs` | Plain-generator runs | Completed WH-347 renders in the free tool, per ISO week. The **control arm** | none — it is the baseline | — |
| `t1.diff_runs` | Diff runs | Completed modification-diff runs (determination number + award date → per-classification diff), per ISO week | — | — |
| `t1.diff_ratio` | Diff ratio | `t1.diff_runs ÷ t1.gen_runs` | **KILL if < 1.0 at week 8.** Directly tests whether provenance outdraws the commodity tool | — |
| `t1.pqs` | Product-qualified starts | Tool sessions that reached a **rendered artifact carrying the footer** — not sessions, not pageviews (Poyar) | — | — |
| `t1.tool_to_account` | Tool → account | Accounts whose `first_entry_path` is a tool path ÷ `t1.pqs` | — | — |
| `t1.tool_to_paid` | Tool → paid | Paid conversions whose `first_entry_path` is a tool path | **HARD KILL if 0 at week 12** | — |

### 2.2 T2 — the programmatic surface (`crm.sc.pull`, `crm.index.sample`, daily)

| id | Metric | Definition | Threshold | Current |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t2.published` | Pages published | Pages emitted by `pages.rebuild` and present in the sitemap. Launch cohort ≈500 | — | — |
| `t2.indexed_share` | Indexed share | Indexed pages ÷ sampled pages, from the URL Inspection API over a random sample. Reported **with n**, because the API allows 2,000 queries/day and 600/minute per property — this is an estimate from a sample, never a census | **KILL if < 20% at week 12.** No ratio published below n=200 | — |
| `t2.impressions` | Impressions | Search Console `impressions`, by page and date | **KILL if no month-over-month growth for three consecutive months** | — |
| `t2.clicks_to_tools` | Clicks into T1 | Sessions entering at `/rates/` or `/wd/` that start a tool run | — | — |
| `t2.assisted_accounts` | Assisted accounts | Accounts whose `first_entry_path` is a `/rates/` or `/wd/` path | — | — |
| `t2.control_delta` | Cohort vs control | `t2.indexed_share` per template minus the same for the free-generator pages | **Day 90: any template below the control arm is DELETED, not iterated** | — |
| `t2.head_term_page1` | County × craft page one | Page-one presence for any head term on the county × craft sub-surface | **KILL that sub-surface independently at week 16.** It must not drag the determination pages with it | — |

### 2.3 T3 — SEM as an instrument (`crm.sem.meter`, daily)

| id | Metric | Definition | Threshold | Current |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t3.spend_cum` | Cumulative spend | Account spend since first impression | **KILL at $2,000 with zero purchases** — under two Solo affordable-CAC budgets | — |
| `t3.purchases` | $49 purchases | Completed Stripe purchases of the bid rate card attributed to a paid session | — | — |
| `t3.cost_per_purchase` | Cost per purchase | `t3.spend_cum ÷ t3.purchases`. **CPC is an output of this test, never an input** | **KILL if > $47 for two consecutive weeks.** The rate card's contribution is $46.98, so above that line the instrument stops self-funding | — |

### 2.4 The artifact loop (`crm.verify.count`, daily)

| id | Metric | Definition | Threshold | Current |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `loop.artifacts` | Artifacts generated | Certifiable filings released. The denominator, and it does not exist yet | — | — |
| `loop.verify_3p` | Third-party verification loads per 100 artifacts | Loads of a per-artifact verification URL from a session that is **not** the generating account, by referrer and session class | No threshold. There is **no coefficient**, so no target may be asserted | — |
| `loop.first_session_verify` | Accounts entering at a verification URL | Accounts whose first session began at a verification URL | — | — |

### 2.5 Money and retention (Stripe; `crm.review.close` weekly)

| id | Metric | Definition | Threshold | Current |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mo.paying` | Paying accounts | Active subscriptions by tier | — | — |
| `mo.mrr` | MRR | Sum of active subscription value, tiers per D4 ($99 / $249 / $599) | — | — |
| `mo.contribution` | Contribution | Revenue less variable cost. Modelled at ≈$0.06 per certified filing against ≈$175/month fixed platform cost | — | — |
| `mo.net_new_vs_burn` | Net new ARR against cash burned | Poyar's preferred efficiency read, because CAC payback misleads for self-serve | — | — |
| `mo.refund_rate` | Self-serve refund rate | In-app refunds ÷ purchases. A rising rate is the signal that the boundary list is not disqualifying the wrong buyer early enough | — | — |
| `mo.dunning_recovered` | Dunning recovery | Recovered ÷ failed payments, from the Stripe webhook path | — | — |

## 3. GATED — measured internally, may not be printed

These metrics exist as counters from day one. **What is gated is the sentence, not the measurement.**
The renderer emits the mechanism sentence while the flag is false and the measured sentence, with its
numbers and dates injected, when it is true. A human editing copy cannot promote any of them.

| Metric | Gate | Unlocks when | Printable **today** | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Golden-suite exact-match rate | **G1** / F-1 | ≥500-line suite over ≥25 determinations in ≥8 states, 100% exact match, **30 consecutive green days** | "All money arithmetic is deterministic code under property tests. No model touches it. A divergence blocks both corpus promotion and the build." | **GATED** |
| Acceptance count | **G2** / F-2 | ≥50 WH-347s **and** ≥25 CA eCPR files confirmed accepted, XSD hash green throughout | "Generated to the DOL form geometry; the XML validates against the published schema. **Generated, not acceptance-tested.**" | **GATED** |
| Corpus completeness | **G3** / F-3 | 60 days of zero unexplained reconciliation delta above 0.5% | "N active determinations mirrored as of *(timestamp)*. Reconciliation delta: x%. Last successful crawl: *(timestamp)*." — the live status page | **GATED** (mechanism sentence is live) |
| `csv_to_artifact_seconds` median | **G4** / F-4 | ≥100 real filings | "Ratepin reads a payroll CSV and writes the WH-347 and the eCPR XML. There is no queue and no turnaround window." | **GATED** |
| `human_minutes` per customer per month | **G5** / F-4 | 90 days below 2 min/customer/month at ≥50 paying accounts. The counter increments on **every** inbound message to the billing address, with minutes by wall-clock to first reply — the party that benefits does not define the denominator | "There is no support queue. No human reviews any output, at any tier. Refunds are a button." | **GATED** |
| Staleness auto-credit | **G6** / F-4 | The chaos test passes at both scales, upstream killed in staging | *(silence — the mechanism may be built and may fire; it may not be marketed)* | **GATED** |

**Two dashboard-specific gate rules.** No acquisition metric on this page may be restated as a
customer-facing outcome, in any form — a conversion rate is not a claim about the product, and a
channel result is not evidence of correctness. And `claims.json` arriving unsigned, stale or
unverifiable renders **every** row of this section as GATED, fail-closed, per A5.

---

## 4. Metrics we refuse to compute, and why

| Refused | Why |
|---|---|
| Pageviews, sessions or impressions as a success metric | They measure supply of pages, not demand for the product. T2's success metric is indexation and downstream tool starts |
| MQLs, SQLs, leads, pipeline, contact counts | There are no person records here (`CRM.md` §1). Inventing a lead stage would be a lie about the mechanism |
| A viral coefficient for the artifact loop | Weinberg & Mares require a measurable *k* with a cycle time. We have neither, and a *k* computed from a footer that is often printed or faxed would be unfalsifiable and flattering at once |
| Time-saved or money-saved figures of any kind | F-4. Even a correctly-read external burden estimate would say nothing about Ratepin, because nobody has measured Ratepin |
| Any characterisation or count of the open-shop 5–75-employee segment | `research/01-demand-pmf.md` found no source that sizes it. `BRAND.md` C-B5 forbids printing a segment size no source supports |
| Enforcement-frequency series as a demand indicator | DBRA concluded compliance actions fell from 1,711 in FY2013 to 641 in FY2025 (WHD fiscal-year data, read 2026-08-13). The buying trigger we actually observe is the GC withholding the progress draw, which happens weekly regardless |
| NPS or any survey | It is a message to a person about a product whose entire premise is that no message is required, and no decision on this page turns on it |

---

## 5. How a number reaches a public surface

One path, and it does not run through this file.

1. A measurement job writes the value and its flag into `claims.json` and **signs** it.
2. The renderer verifies the signature and `generated_at` freshness before rendering any measured
   sentence; an unverifiable file renders the mechanism sentence in every slot.
3. `CL-1` fails the build if a measured-claim template string appears outside the renderer.
4. `CL-2`, the load-bearing check, fails the build for any number on a Scope A surface that does not
   resolve to `BRAND.md` §5.5 or `claims.json` with an as-of date.
5. A regression flips the flag on the next measurement run and the live sentence narrows within one
   job interval — P-C, executed by the scheduler, not by anyone noticing.

**This dashboard is a read model.** Copying a figure from it onto a page is a red build, not a
shortcut.
